capabilities: chat with configured AI providers in a right-sidebar panel
gather vault context from the active note, selection, links, backlinks, and search matches
apply provider-proposed vault writes according to the chosen access mode
run provider controls and vault skill files through slash commands
store and replay past conversation messages across sessions
extras: Desktop-only in v1. The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Sends active requests and selected vault context to the configured provider; supports read-only, confirm, and full-access vault write modes; can read skill files from ~/.agent/skills and ~/.agents/skills.
intentEvidence: AI Sidebar adds a Cursor/VS Code-style assistant panel to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI panel that can use local CLI agents or API providers with automatic vault context to answer questions and propose note edits.

relations.evidence: Codex: click Sign in to launch the local codex login flow.
Claude Code: click Sign in to launch the local claude auth login flow
opencode: click Sign in to launch opencode auth login
OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral: click Get key, paste the provider key

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral)
provider subscriptions or Console auth for OAuth/CLI agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider)
local CLI agents installed on the desktop (Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Gemini CLI, Aider)

summary: AI assistant sidebar that connects local CLI agents or API providers to vault context for chatting about and editing notes.
